$Comment: Phase 3 (Fridjitzu) copy of AT_Ice_King_Summon (2026-10-21: in the summon he should hold the nunchucks as in his other animations). The staff cast set (AT_Ice_King_Staff) posed his arm for a staff, so the nunchucks sat wrong in his hand. Same summon (circle, hand glow, 2 s still, bolt down that spawns 2 Gunters), but with the nunchuck set AT_Ice_King_Nunchucks: SpinSwingLeftCharging (looping spin overhead, shout face) while he calls, SpinSwingLeftCharged (the spin swing, clenched face) when the bolt goes down. Used by CAE_AT_Ice_King_Fridjitzu through Root_AT_Ice_King_Summon_Fridjitzu. 2026-10-21 (playtest: an effect on his hands whenever he casts): ice-blue hand glow AT_Ice_King_Summon_Energy on R-Hand and L-Hand during the charge. 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): VO_Charge when the charge starts, VO_Summon on the cast; the laugh plays where the Gunters appear (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Summon).

Interactions.$Comment: SpawnNPC needs a target block, which an NPC attack never has, so it failed silently and no Gunter came out (2026-10-21). The bolt hits the ground at his feet and its ProjectileMiss runs the SpawnNPC.
